notes: Reviewed affirmative-action extension. Annual wording variants are separate records sharing one family without overlapping years. Support maps to liberal +1; opposition to conservative -1; intermediate responses to +/-1/3. Missing responses and invalid weights excluded. Employment and college admissions are combined in the original question, not separately measured.

entries.title: Affirmative action in employment and college admissions for racial minorities and women
entries.question: Affirmative action programs give preference to racial minorities and to women in employment and college admissions in order to correct for discrimination. Do you support or oppose affirmative action?
entries.rationale: Support coded liberal; opposition conservative. Four ordered responses mapped to +1, +1/3, -1/3, -1. Original question combines employment and college admissions; it does not measure either separately. Wording variants share one family; changes in wording can affect the trend.
